outcome: Vaginal Birth After previous Caesarean Section (VBAC) rate
cohort: 3266 women giving birth at Aga Khan Hospital for Women, Karimabad, Karachi, from October 2011 to September 2012
finding: The study found that the rates of CS, VBAC trials, and successful VBACs at a secondary care hospital in Karachi were comparable to international rates.
mod_finding: Out of 3266 deliveries, 1021 (31.26%) were CS, and out of 365 women with a previous CS, 33 (9%) attempted VBAC, with a 63.6% success rate.
